# ExpressoTS (monorepo)

> TypeScript-first Node.js framework built on Express 5, with dependency
> injection, lifecycle hooks, providers and a testing toolkit.

This repository publishes several packages. Each ships its own guidance for
language models in its package root, which is also what npm installs:

- `packages/core/llms.txt` — @expressots/core: bootstrap, container, decorators,
  providers, testing, and the list of v3 names removed in v4.
- Scaffolded projects carry an `AGENTS.md` with the same rules (see `templates/`).
- Installed projects can print the current guidance with `expressots llms`.

Docs: https://doc.expresso-ts.com
